import pandas as pd

def compute_missingness(input_file, output_file):
    # Read the input file
    data = pd.read_csv(input_file)

    # Compute missing rate for each indicator
    missing_rates = data.isnull().mean().to_frame('missing_rate')

    # Compute missing count for each indicator
    missing_counts = data.isnull().sum().to_frame('missing_count')

    # Merge missing rates and counts into a single dataframe
    missing_report = pd.merge(missing_rates, missing_counts, left_index=True, right_index=True)

    # Mark indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30 as kept
    missing_report['kept'] = missing_report['missing_rate'] <= 0.30

    # Write the missingness report to a CSV file
    missing_report.to_csv(output_file, index=True, quotechar='"')

def select_indicators(input_file, output_file):
    # Read the input file
    data = pd.read_csv(input_file)

    # Keep only the city_id, city_name, year, and indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
    selected_data = data[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + data.isnull().mean().to_frame('missing_rate').index[missing_report['missing_rate'] <= 0.30].tolist()]

    # Write the selected matrix to a CSV file
    selected_data.to_csv(output_file, index=False, quotechar='"')

# Compute missingness report
compute_missingness('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv', 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv')

# Select indicators
select_indicators('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv', 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv')
